name: arenallm-local-agent
description: Prompt-first bounded local agent for repository review, focused edits, audits, and reference-backed image jobs.

tools.name: run_arenallm
tools.side_effects: executes only allowlisted local tools; patches and image jobs require explicit approval

tools.name: repo_search
tools.side_effects: none; bounded result count and file size

tools.name: repo_patch
tools.side_effects: one exact-match local file patch; no Git operation; explicit approval required

tools.name: run_fixed_audit
tools.side_effects: runs only the fixed repository validators

tools.name: queue_qwen_image_edit
tools.side_effects: uploads references to local ComfyUI and queues one image job; explicit approval required
